prompts.task: Perform only read-only supplemental verification of the selected AO resource policy in ./service. Copy the supplied canonical packet to .observe and validate its existing bindings; keep its incomplete outcomes intact. In a separate .observe/tmp packet, invoke the bundled selection command for AO-002 with --ao-reuse-only and no resource-name or ID flags. Verify a schema-v3 policy-only ao_target with create_if_missing=false, unchanged dependency-closed finding scope, and a changed selection digest. Render its HTML and inspect/test that both optional resource fields may stay blank while the reuse-only policy reaches the generated instrumentation command; partial explicit selector pairs remain invalid. Exercise the supplied snapshot of the actual resource helper with credential-free fake SDK clients and temporary process env names/IDs, proving both-existing reuses and an absent named stream makes zero create calls under --reuse-only. Keep supplied source, real env profiles and original canonical evidence unchanged; use only scratch harnesses under .observe/tmp. Write durable supplemental evidence and a concise reader report. No SDK download, services, gateway, model/cloud calls or live resource creation. Local fake proof does not close missing cloud resource/receipt or logger lifecycle evidence.

Does not replace the implementation or infer no creation from source text alone.
